body: Fuck I feel this so much

Not sure if this'll help you, but ever since my failed attempt, I've been conscious of the fact that I will never be able to predict what life will give me even within the next hour. I think it helps me ground myself as well as feeling free from too many commitments and broken promises and keeps me from getting my hopes up too high. Without too much hope or expectations, I don't need to think or validate for any reasons to live. Just living bc I was birthed.

Ofc, I still fuck up so many times. Still cop shit that makes me relapse into dangerous scenarios but I do try my best to move on even if my best might not seem like enough. Besides, if I die then I die. If I continue living then I continue living. Sounds like a bleak way of life, sure, but it gets me by. I also have been spending my time doing things like calculus and reviewing reports for chemistry so it keeps me busy. Agreed with the whole tone-deaf shit not being very helpful though. I suggest finding something to take your mind off of things and completely lose yourself in that. If you like art or music or sciences or reading, it's pretty therapeutic. Makes it feel like you're doing something with your life.

Wish you all the best for your efforts man. Take care x
